_comment: Emberreach general store. 'cost' is gold, not settlement stores: this is the convenience counter for a player who needs a material now and does not want to wait for it. Every line is priced at 2.5x the item's sell value per bundle, so buying is never a shortcut past the skill that makes the item - only a way to unblock yourself. A test asserts that margin holds, so a future edit cannot quietly turn the store into a currency printer. Nothing here is a raw trace or a capstone: the raw gathering actions stay the only source of those, and skillcapes stay at the mastery stall.
